_about: Public-domain Heinrich August Wilhelm Meyer (1800-1873, Hanover New Testament exegete) in English for the Word Hoard: his own fifteen volumes of the Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the New Testament, Matthew to Philemon (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1873-1881), ed. William P. Dickson and others, from Internet Archive scans. The volumes by his continuators Lünemann and Huther are on their own shelves. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
